findings.recommendation: Inspect browser developer console logs, fix unhandled exceptions, and ensure third-party scripts load safely.

findings.title: Missing Defensive HTTP Security Headers (2 missing)
findings.observation: The web server response does not include standard defensive headers: Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS), X-Content-Type-Options.
findings.evidence: Response headers from https://som.com/ were inspected. Found: {"hsts":null,"csp":"frame-ancestors 'self';","xFrameOptions":"SAMEORIGIN","xContentTypeOptions":null,"referrerPolicy":null,"permissionsPolicy":null}
findings.impact: Leaves the website vulnerable to clickjacking (missing X-Frame-Options), MIME-type sniffing, and cross-site scripting risks.
findings.recommendation: Configure your web server (Nginx/Apache/Cloudflare) to send HSTS, X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff headers.

findings.title: Broken Links / 404 HTTP Responses (1 detected)
findings.observation: Encountered 1 broken resource or link requests returning HTTP 404 Not Found status.
findings.evidence: 404 status codes received during crawling across 1 inspected pages.
findings.impact: Degrades user experience, damages SEO crawl budget, and creates dead-end navigation for visitors.
findings.recommendation: Audit all internal hyperlinks, update or redirect obsolete URLs, and ensure all asset paths are valid.

findings.title: Improper H1 Heading Structure (0 missing, 1 multiple H1s)
findings.observation: 0 page(s) have no <h1> tag, and 1 page(s) have multiple <h1> tags.
findings.evidence: Inspected 1 pages. Heading hierarchy should feature exactly one main H1 per page followed by logical H2s and H3s.
findings.impact: Impairs search engine understanding of the page topic and causes screen readers confusion for accessible navigation.
findings.recommendation: Ensure every page contains exactly one unique, descriptive <h1> tag at the top of the content structure.

findings.title: Images Missing Alt Text (13/18 images)
findings.observation: 13 images on the website lack descriptive alt attributes.
findings.evidence: Found across crawled pages. Sample missing alt images detected in DOM.
findings.impact: Prevents image search indexing in Google Images and makes visual content inaccessible to visually impaired users using screen readers.
findings.recommendation: Add concise, descriptive alt text to all meaningful images. Use empty alt="" for purely decorative background elements.

findings.title: Images Missing Accessible Alt Text (13 detected)
findings.observation: 13 image elements do not provide textual alternatives via alt attributes.
findings.impact: Assistive technology users (such as screen readers) cannot perceive the meaning or context of graphical content.
findings.recommendation: Add meaningful alt attributes describing the content or function of each image.

findings.title: Target Location (Chicago / Global) Missing from Primary SEO Elements
findings.observation: The specified target geography "Chicago / Global" was not prominently detected in page titles, meta descriptions, or main headings.
findings.evidence: Crawled 1 pages. Checked <title>, <meta description>, and <h1> tags against location "Chicago / Global".
findings.impact: Reduces visibility in localized search queries, Google Maps / Local Pack results, and nearby customer discovery.
findings.recommendation: Incorporate "Chicago / Global" naturally into the homepage title tag, H1 heading, service area sections, and footer contact block.

findings.title: Visual Hierarchy & Focal Point Modernization
findings.observation: Above-the-fold layout could benefit from stronger headline typography contrast, clear primary call-to-action prominence, and elevated modern spacing tokens.
findings.evidence: Evaluated 1 crawled templates. Visual inspection of hero and body sections indicates opportunity for enhanced visual contrast and modern design tokens.
findings.impact: Modern, high-contrast visual design builds instant visitor trust and dramatically improves engagement time on landing.
findings.recommendation: Implement a refined typographic hierarchy (48px+ H1 hero, 20px lead paragraph), distinct high-contrast CTA button styling, and consistent 64px+ section spacing.

findings.title: Lead Capture & Instant Engagement Opportunity
findings.observation: The website lacks instant real-time conversion channels such as floating WhatsApp buttons or frictionless 2-field lead capture forms.
findings.evidence: Inspected conversion triggers across 1 pages. Direct WhatsApp messaging links or streamlined quote forms were not detected in the primary navigation or sticky footer.
findings.impact: Up to 60% of modern mobile visitors prefer instant chat or 1-click quote requests over navigating to a separate contact page.
findings.recommendation: Add a persistent floating WhatsApp contact widget and an above-the-fold "Get Instant Quote" trigger.

clientSummary.overview: A strategic review of SOM Architecture & Interior Design's website to help you increase client inquiries, improve Google visibility, and create a premium first impression for potential customers.

top5Opportunities.title: 1. Fast Inbound Contact Triggers
top5Opportunities.businessImpact: Captures urgent buyers who prefer calling or chatting instantly on mobile rather than filling out long forms.
top5Opportunities.recommendedAction: Add a prominent 1-click "Call Now" button in the header and a sticky WhatsApp chat button on mobile.

top5Opportunities.title: 2. Above-The-Fold Value & Proof
top5Opportunities.businessImpact: Immediately answers "Why choose us?" within the first 5 seconds of a visitor landing on the website.
top5Opportunities.recommendedAction: Place a clear headline stating your primary specialty, accompanied by 3 core benefit badges and client review ratings.

top5Opportunities.title: 3. Dedicated Solution / Service Pages
top5Opportunities.businessImpact: Allows Google to rank each specific service individually for targeted search queries in your area.
top5Opportunities.recommendedAction: Build dedicated sub-pages for each major offering with project photos, client benefits, and an inquiry form.

top5Opportunities.title: 4. Search Engine Snippet Optimization
top5Opportunities.businessImpact: Improves the descriptive summary that prospective clients see on Google search result pages.
top5Opportunities.recommendedAction: Craft compelling 150-character descriptions for each page inviting searchers to click and explore.

top5Opportunities.title: 5. Modern Mobile Layout & Tap Targets
top5Opportunities.businessImpact: Eliminates pinch-to-zoom and mis-taps on smartphones, ensuring a seamless experience for on-the-go clients.
top5Opportunities.recommendedAction: Ensure all buttons and menus are at least 48px in height with generous spacing between clickable elements.

executiveSummary.summary:
This comprehensive website audit evaluates the digital presence, customer journey, and conversion readiness of https://som.com (SOM Architecture & Interior Design in Chicago / Global). 
Based on 1 inspected pages and automated viewport testing, the website provides a foundational web presence with substantial commercial opportunities to accelerate customer trust, improve mobile engagement, and capture more inbound enquiries.

Key immediate priorities include introducing frictionless quote inquiry channels, refining page summaries for search engines, and modernizing layout contrast to highlight core services and proof of quality.

topRisks: Missing immediate call or instant messaging buttons for high-intent visitors.
